messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Old versions of INLA
parts:
Hi,

Is it possible to download old versions of INLA? I need to run some stuff on my university cluster and I have just found that they have R 2.14 with an old kernel and the current binaries do not work.

Compiling INLA myself is not an option as some of the requires libraries and headers are not installed.

So, do you have a repository for old versions of INLA? I know that CRAN keeps pre-compiled binaries for older versions of R but I have no idea about INLA.

Best wishes,

Virgilio
